clauses.quote: a cover letter shall be provided by SAEA to the site principal or his/her designee authorizing the posting and/or distribution to the mail boxes, along with a copy of the materials to be posted and/or entered into the mailboxes.
clauses.notes: SAEA is the local union chapter; duty falls on worker to provide authorization to management.

clauses.quote: Posting of election materials on the designated bulletin board(s) and/or the placing of election materials in mail boxes shall be allowed.
clauses.subject_text: Posting of election materials on the designated bulletin board(s) and/or the placing of election materials in mail boxes

clauses.quote: Said materials shall involve the internal elections of the Association

clauses.notes: Relief from duty rather than positive prohibition.

clauses.quote: Authorized representatives of SAEA shall be permitted the use of district email, faxes, and other electronic devices to transact official Association business provided the business does not interfere with the instructional process and/or interfere with the performance of assignments made by the administrator.
Email, faxes, and other electronic devices may not be utilized to encourage or condone illegal activities.
clauses.subject_text: Email, faxes, and other electronic devices

clauses.quote: Email may be used by unit members outside times of active instruction such as before and after school and during duty free lunches.
Association shall have the right to sign and process all grievances without the presence of the unit member on whose behalf the grievance is being processed.

Authorized representatives of the Association shall be permitted to transact official Association business on school property provided the business does not interfere with the instructional process and/or interfere with the performance of assignments made by the administrator.
Tuesday shall be designated as Association meeting day.
clauses.notes: Management duty to schedule/recognize a specific meeting day.

clauses.quote: No meetings with required attendance by unit members will be scheduled from the end of the school day until 7:00 p.m.
clauses.subject_text: No meetings with required attendance by unit members

clauses.quote: no meetings with required attendance by unit members will be scheduled after the end of the school day.
clauses.subject_text: no meetings with required attendance by unit members

clauses.quote: Voluntary attendance meetings on Tuesdays will be limited.
